brief.headline: SK Hynix 93% of Samsung market cap; Samsung ships HBM4E samples 1H ahead of SK Hynix; DRAM +58-63% Q2, NAND +70-75%; hyperscaler capex $700B+
brief.summary: <cite index="40-4,40-9">SK Hynix market cap reached 93.2% of Samsung's as of May 29, closing a gap that stood at less than 50% a year ago</cite>. <cite index="43-2,43-4">Samsung began shipping 12-stack HBM4E samples today—offering 20% performance improvement over HBM4—potentially overtaking SK Hynix, which is expected to supply HBM4E samples in late 2026</cite>. <cite index="11-7,14-16">DRAM contract prices are projected to rise 58-63% QoQ in Q2 2026 following a record 90-95% jump in Q1, while NAND Flash will climb 70-75% QoQ</cite>. <cite index="25-5,25-9">Microsoft, Meta, Amazon, and Alphabet collectively will spend roughly $700 billion on capex in 2026, nearly double 2025</cite>. <cite index="6-1,6-22">SK Hynix's entire 2026 HBM allocation is sold out, with shortages projected into 2027</cite>.
brief.pair_trade_view: Samsung compressed 12-18 months of catch-up into Q1-Q2; HBM4E sample lead flips narrative. SK Hynix still owns 70% of HBM4 for Nvidia Rubin per UBS, but Samsung's HBM4E timing advantage into 2H26 could trigger reallocation by hyperscalers hedging single-source risk. Near-term: Samsung outperforms on de-risked qualification cycle + foundry optionality. Medium-term: watch SK Hynix HBM4E sample timing in 2H26 and whether Nvidia splits Rubin Ultra orders. Samsung preferred over common for leverage to memory ASP without full Device Solutions drag. Relative target: Samsung +8-12% vs SK Hynix +3-5% next 90 days, assuming no macro shock.

memory_cycle.stage: Late-stage supercycle, pricing peak expected Q3-Q4 2026
memory_cycle.notes: <cite index="5-14">BofA forecasts 2026 global DRAM revenue to surge 51% YoY and NAND 45%, with ASPs rising 33% and 26% respectively</cite>. <cite index="4-1">Goldman Sachs forecasts 4.9% DRAM supply deficit in 2026</cite>. <cite index="19-16">New fab capacity not expected to reach meaningful production volume before late 2027 or 2028</cite>. <cite index="15-25">HBM carries 3-to-1 conversion ratio vs DDR5 wafer capacity, compressing conventional DRAM supply</cite>. Spot stabilization signals shift from panic buying to long-term contracts; expect QoQ pricing deceleration Q3 onward but no correction until 2H27.

brief.hbm_pulse: <cite index="5-18">BofA estimates 2026 HBM market at $54.6 billion, +58% YoY</cite>. <cite index="5-5,5-27">UBS predicts SK Hynix will achieve ~70% market share in HBM4 for Nvidia's Rubin platform in 2026</cite>. Samsung's HBM4E sample shipment today breaks SK Hynix's first-mover monopoly; <cite index="43-17">SK Hynix expected to supply HBM4E samples in 2H 2026, mass production 2027</cite>. <cite index="2-13">SK Hynix announced iHBM thermal architecture cutting thermal resistance 30%, targeting HBM5</cite>. <cite index="3-4,3-5,3-6">Korean memory makers discussing new architecture placing GPUs and HBM in separate packages connected via optical links, potentially supporting several times more HBM than current designs</cite>. Micron HBM3E 36GB integrated into AMD MI350; Intel Crescent Island pivots to LPDDR5X to dodge HBM shortage. Supply remains binding constraint through 2027.

news_pulse.headline: Samsung ships world-first HBM4E samples, 12-stack 48GB at 16 Gbps, 20% faster than HBM4
news_pulse.implication: Samsung leapfrogs SK Hynix on next-gen HBM timeline by 6+ months; de-risks Nvidia Rubin supply and AMD MI400 qualification. KB Securities raised target to ₩530k on May 28 citing 25% memory cost share in Nvidia Vera Rubin platform.

news_pulse.headline: SK Hynix market cap reaches 93.2% of Samsung's, gap narrows to 6.8% as shares surge 1,000% YoY
news_pulse.implication: KOSPI concentration risk: Samsung + SK Hynix >40% of index weight. Single HBM demand correction cascades into pension/retail portfolios. Passive rebalancing flows could trigger volatility if gap closes further.

news_pulse.headline: Retail investors pour ₩2 trillion into Samsung/SK Hynix 2x leverage ETFs in first 45 minutes of trading
news_pulse.implication: New leverage products amplify intraday volatility and create forced-flow dynamics. KOSPI hit 8,450 intraday. Crowding indicator: euphoric positioning into peak pricing cycle raises downside risk if Q3 pricing decelerates.

news_pulse.headline: DRAM contract prices +58-63% Q2 2026, NAND +70-75% following Q1's record 90-95% DRAM surge
news_pulse.implication: NAND outpacing DRAM for first time this cycle as enterprise SSD demand absorbs capacity. Suppliers prioritizing server over client; eMMC/UFS tightest. Pricing deceleration from Q1 suggests peak approaching but no rollover until 2H27 capacity comes online.

news_pulse.headline: Hyperscaler 2026 capex hits $700-725 billion, up ~75% YoY; Meta raised guidance to $125-145B
news_pulse.implication: Structural bid for HBM/server DRAM continues; no capex slowdown signaled despite Meta shares -9% on higher component pricing disclosure. Memory consuming ~30% of capex per BofA, underpinning Samsung/SK Hynix revenue visibility through 2027.

news_pulse.headline: TSMC CoWoS capacity hits 120-130k wpm by end-2026, up from 75k in late 2025; Nvidia secures 60%
news_pulse.implication: Advanced packaging bottleneck easing; Nvidia locked 510k CoWoS-L wafers for Rubin/GB100. AMD MI400 uses ~11% allocation. Constraint shifting from packaging to HBM supply as TSMC ramps—reinforces memory pricing power.

news_pulse.headline: SK Hynix 2026 HBM allocation fully sold out; UBS forecasts 70% share of Nvidia Rubin HBM4
news_pulse.implication: Zero incremental allocation availability for 2026; customers contracting 2027 delivery now. HBM scarcity = binding constraint on AI scaling through 2027. Alternative LPDDR5X architectures (Intel Crescent Island) gain credibility as hedges.

news_pulse.headline: Samsung and SK Hynix join Anthropic strategic investment round; strengthening AI ecosystem ties
news_pulse.implication: Vertical integration playbook: lock hyperscaler/AI lab equity stakes to secure long-term offtake + co-development. Mirrors Google-Anthropic, Microsoft-OpenAI structures. Reduces customer concentration risk for Samsung.

brief.derivatives_signal: KOSPI hit 8,450 intraday May 29 as single-stock 2x leverage ETFs for Samsung/SK Hynix launched; ₩2 trillion volume in 45 minutes signals retail FOMO. Implied volatility likely elevated; options skew should favor puts as euphoric positioning into Q2 earnings (late July) raises downside risk if DRAM pricing deceleration accelerates or hyperscaler capex guides disappoint. Monitor KOSPI concentration: Samsung + SK Hynix >40% weighting creates systemic index risk. USD/KRW stable but ₩ strength on export optimism could pressure Samsung's Device Solutions operating leverage.
watch_for_next_3h: Samsung HBM4E customer feedback: any Nvidia/AMD/Broadcom commentary on sample validation timeline vs SK Hynix HBM4
Seoul close: whether SK Hynix sustains ₩2.29M level or profit-taking accelerates on Samsung catch-up narrative
Hyperscaler/Nvidia earnings call transcripts (archive): incremental commentary on HBM supply agreements, CoWoS allocation, or 2027 capex outlook
TrendForce or DRAMeXchange spot pricing updates: watch for any May contract settlement data confirming Q2 +58-63% trajectory
China YMTC HBM development news: any acceleration in domestic HBM3E production would pressure Samsung/SK Hynix long-term pricing power (low probability near-term)
